- team_stats_get_top_scorer(team_name, competition?) -> returns top scorer of that team in that competition. We can use it for Manchester United, competition=Premier League.

- league_stats_get_top_scorer(league_name, season?) -> returns top scorer of that league in that season. We can use it for Premier League, season=2019-2020.
